name: Rohan Deshmukh
comment: Best Kurkure Momos and Tandoori Momos in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar! Super crispy, juicy, and very affordable at ₹150 for two people.

name: Priya Sharma
comment: The Pizza Momos and Afghani Momos here are amazing. Very quick takeaway service and great indoor seating right opposite Golden Quarter.

name: Amit Kulkarni
comment: Fast home delivery and hot steamed paneer momos. The red garlic chutney dip is authentic Tibetan style!
